$comment: Benchmark fixtures (BENCHMARK_STRATEGY §3, P01-13). 'reference' fixtures are pinned clones in a disposable cache and give reproducible results. 'dogfood' reads a live working tree and is labeled non-reproducible. Tier boundaries count indexed files after ignore rules; 'tierBasis' says whether the tier was measured or is still assumed.

fixtures.$comment: Cloned from the local repository (read-only) into the cache at the pinned commit. localSource is relative to the CIE repository root.
The live working tree, read in place with CIE state in a separate --state-dir. Results record the commit and the dirty flag and are never used as reference baselines.
